title: Robust mixed-state SLD-QFIM probe design
difficulty_explanation: The solver must differentiate a noisy mixed-state circuit, form stable three-parameter SLD-QFIMs on fixed support, and optimize a robust log-determinant objective across an ensemble.
claim_boundary: The repaired expert passes the three frozen public evaluator seeds in the pinned image and an independent three-formula QFIM canary. The single 179.48-second observation has only 0.52 seconds of margin to the nominal 180-second expert target and does not establish p95 runtime. This is direct expert-canary evidence only: the evaluator still lacks the full single-seed case-identity/admission protocol, no authenticated Harbor or LLM-policy audit has run, no private holdout is frozen, no human promotion is recorded, and no GPT-5.6-sol trial has run. Difficulty remains a hypothesis.

scientific_contract.objective: worst-case logdet(F + 0.04 I) with a minimum-eigenvalue gate

tensorcircuit_central_path: TensorCircuit DMCircuit for every noisy sensing state
JAX derivatives through DMCircuit density matrices
independent_oracle: NumPy/SciPy density propagation, finite differences, spectral SLD formula, and a separate vectorized SLD equation

validation.validation_scope: direct pinned-image evaluator and formula canary; not authenticated prequalification

previous_rejected_expert.reason: The original expert optimized only the four supplied theta points and selected by training minimum eigenvalue, overfitting seed 101051. The replacement uses a deterministic public-box design ensemble and hard robust-score selection without changing evaluator gates.

admission_blockers: Upgrade the evaluator to one verifier-only base seed, emit and flush one full 64-hex case identity before untrusted code, and scrub all seed variables before import.
Add candidate-specific expert-admission metrics, fixed threshold-policy hashing, and exact materialized-task bindings before the safe runner may collect prequalification evidence.
Prequalify at least 25 private seed/digest records in the pinned image with runtime, memory, fixed-support, robust-gain, minimum-QFIM, and formula-agreement margins.
Complete human physics/framework/independent review plus authenticated expert Harbor functional, static, and LLM-policy audit before any solver manifest.
One clean GPT-5.6-sol/high pass vetoes this frozen design; failures require two independent substantive-failure auditors.
api_risks: DMCircuit.depolarizing(px, py, pz) and densitymatrix() are required and were canaried only against tensorcircuit-nightly 1.7.0.dev20260618.
The expert requests JAX x64 and TensorCircuit complex128; a build that disables x64 can lose SLD stability.
The independent oracle assumes TensorCircuit's RXX/RYY/RZZ convention exp(-i theta P/2) and leftmost qubit-0 tensor ordering.
Differentiating through a 16x16 complex linear solve exercises higher-order JAX autodiff and is the primary compilation risk.
